text:
mike (SRE): Heads up — follow-up from last night's postmortem about missing spans + bad aggregation. Dashboards still show underreported p95s for model_inference. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-22-observability-aggregation

maria (Data): I dug into the ETL trace enrichment. culprit: the span-join step is skipping messages when the `trace_id` is null after our dedupe stage. quick logs:
```
2026-03-22T02:14:03Z WARN span-join: missing trace_id for msg_id=abc123, dropping
2026-03-22T02:14:03Z INFO dedupe: kept msg_id=abc123 (duplicate=false)
```
Root cause appears to be an edge-case in the dedupe TTL where traces from old runs come through.

alex (Platform): On the metrics side, the aggregation service is double-counting a batch boundary and then the rollup job discards the later window, so net underreporting. I can PR a fix to the windowing logic.

samira (PM): What's the customer impact? Do we have users seeing wrong billing/alerts? need to communicate if it's >24h of bad metrics.

mike (SRE): Affected dashboards are internal + a small set of customers using advanced SLAs — I'll surface to support. Action plan proposals below.

maria (Data): Action A1: Fix ETL span-join to tolerate null trace_id and add unit+integration test. Owner: maria (Data). ETA: 48h. Backfill plan: re-run enrichment on 2026-03-22 ingestion window. Jira: DATA-452.

alex (Platform): Action A2: Patch aggregation windowing, add property-based tests for boundary alignment, and a canary release to dedicated. Owner: alex (Platform). ETA: 72h. Jira: PLAT-318.

jordan (Eng): Action A3: Add a realtime alert when span ingestion falls below 95% of baseline for 15m. Owner: mike (SRE). ETA: 24h to create rule + runbook update.

samira (PM): Action A4: Customer comms draft + status page note. Owner: samira (PM). ETA: 24h for initial draft, send after confirmation of backfill window.

mike (SRE): Noting recurring pattern: spikes on heavy ingestion weekends where Kafka partition lag + long GC in enrichment cause dropped spans. Suggest we add a recurring 2-week incident review for three months to detect regressions. Owner: mike (SRE).

maria (Data): I'll also add an integration test that replays weekend high-traffic trace files so we won't regress.

ops-bot: Created issue INF-2026: "Observability: missing spans + aggregation underreporting" (https://redwood.internal/issues/INF-2026) and assigned to [maria (Data), alex (Platform), mike (SRE)].

alex (Platform): Quick note — we should gate the patch behind a feature flag so Dedicated customers can opt-in while we validate.

mike (SRE): Agreed. I'll add rollback instructions to the runbook.

samira (PM): Can each owner paste the PR/issue links here when ready? I'll consolidate into the postmortem follow-up tracker. :thumbsup:

maria (Data): PR for ETL fix opened: https://redwood.internal/pulls/2237 — tests added. Backfill scheduled for 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC.

alex (Platform): Aggregation PR: https://redwood.internal/pulls/2241 — canary starts 2026-03-24 04:00 UTC. Feature flag: `metrics.window_fix`.

mike (SRE): Alert rule: https://redwood.internal/rules/alerts/67 created. Runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/observability-span-loss.

samira (PM): Thanks everyone — I'll update the postmortem with these action items and mark owners/due dates. We'll re-check status in 72h. :white_check_mark:
